title: Earthquake Response
description: How to Drop, Cover, and Hold On, and how to adapt it in bed, in a wheelchair, outdoors, or driving, plus why the doorway and "triangle of life" advice is wrong. Covers gas leaks, unsafe buildings, aftershocks, tsunami risk on the coast, and preparing your home.
shortDescription: Drop, Cover, Hold On; why doorways and the triangle of life fail; gas, tsunamis
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
